exposure: low-frequency electroacupuncture (EA) at PC-6 and HE-7 points
stimulation at two non-acupoints of the shoulder
cohort: 90 otherwise healthy candidates for elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia were enrolled.
finding: Low-frequency electroacupuncture at the PC-6 and HE-7 points reduced the incidence of hypotension (less ephedrine required) and significantly lowered the severity of nausea and occurrence of vomiting in cesarean section patients under spinal anesthesia.
